scenes.say: Uber ka interview question: drivers ka live heatmap kaise banaoge?

scenes.caption:
Har driver, har kuch second mein
location bhejta hai.
scenes.say: Har driver kuch second mein location bhejta hai. Spike aaya, toh hum queue rakhte hain, jaise Kafka.

scenes.caption:
Har cell mein kitne drivers hain,
bas wahi count rakhna hai.
scenes.say: Ab server har cell ka counter rakhta hai. Driver cell mein aaya, count ek badha.
Count ke hisaab se rang: laal matlab zyada, hara matlab kam. Isi ko kehte hain live heatmap.
